features.selection: Context-weighted bag excludes the preceding three styles; eligible rare draws after seven selections, at 12% probability. All 14 covered in 1,200 selection trials in both engines.
features.geometry: Fourteen genuinely different rendering branches: neural branches, facets, polygon wave fronts, opening brackets, checked nodes, sequential arcs, reframing, broken loops, forked trees, converging goals, two-to-one synthesis, ledgers, HolyMind crystal mandala and aligned triads.
features.sound_source: Original deterministic DSP written for this website: modal resonance, seeded texture, warm impacts, irregular note timing and short early reflections. Not real recordings, stock samples or a generative-audio model.
features.gesture_policy: No AudioContext and no sound on page load or before the first trusted brain tap / explicit sound-enable gesture.
features.controls: Sound-only mute and volume persist. Muting never stops always-on visual motion. Three concurrent voices maximum; compressor and controlled gain. No ambient soundtrack.
features.milestones: After sound unlock, assembly 25/50/75/100 crossings play quiet matching cues. Threshold dithering does not replay; a fast jump plays one cue, not four.
features.preserved: Phone-only brain-first, desktop/tablet layout, 37 original images, all 34 skills, pinned 0–100–0 assembly with real leader lines and all prior motion/controls.

limitations: Audio-graph and simulated-touch browser verification do not certify speaker output, perceived sound quality, real-device latency or motion accessibility.
